subject.title: feat: expose rawBody on user messages in plugin hook events

question: Should OpenClaw accept `rawBody` on `before_prompt_build`, legacy `before_agent_start`, and `agent_end` as a public provenance-gated plugin hook contract after the queued-steer ordering bug is repaired?
rationale: Automation can fix the state-ordering bug, but deciding whether this new direct-user raw input field is the permanent plugin API contract requires maintainer API direction.

options.title: Accept after repair
options.body: Fix the queued-steer update order, keep docs/tests aligned, and let this additive optional field become the supported plugin hook surface.

options.title: Defer to broader inbound contract
options.body: Pause this PR and route plugin raw-input needs through the broader trusted inbound-decoration work if maintainers want one canonical surface.

options.title: Reject this hook field
options.body: Close or rework the PR if maintainers do not want hook events to carry a separate direct-user raw input field.

recommendation.title: Accept after repair
recommendation.body: Fix the queued-steer update order, keep docs/tests aligned, and let this additive optional field become the supported plugin hook surface.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged hook-helper review/merge history is the strongest available signal for plugin hook API acceptance.
